contracts_to_satisfy.wiki_page_append_only: record_id = f"{page_id}:r{revision}"; new revision must be max+1; old revisions never overwritten
contracts_to_satisfy.head_index: wiki_page_head record maps bare page_id -> {current_revision_id, revision}; version+head written in one transaction
contracts_to_satisfy.resolution_entrypoint: get_page(page_id) / list_pages(...) are the only sanctioned bare-id reads
contracts_to_satisfy.list_pages_query_complexity: O(1) queries - NO per-head store.get (N+1 forbidden)

deliverables: append-only wiki page writer replacing the upsert-in-place add_page
wiki_page_head index with atomic version+head write in one transaction
get_page()/list_pages() as the only bare-id resolution entrypoints
add_edge and retrieve graph expansion routed through get_page()
managed bridge-edge whitelist (14 types) + same-partition types (3)
list_pages rewritten to a single JOIN query (N+1 fix)
positive AND negative tests for both the revision and the edge semantics
task-local ledger, L3 record, progress log and handoff

positive: old revision still readable after a new revision is created
whitelisted bridge-edge type spanning partitions is ACCEPTED
get_page() resolves a bare page_id that raw store.get('wiki_page', id) cannot
page source, partition and evidence_ids fully readable
negative: directly overwriting an existing revision is REJECTED
edge endpoint that does not exist is REJECTED
performance: store.get call count during list_pages is a CONSTANT, not N (baseline: old code = 0 gets, 1 list)
